# Evidence Pack

## When to use

Use whenever artifacts are added or modified.

## Instructions

Maintain `06-evidence-index.md` with control, artifact, description, owner, and status. Include assessment, architecture, IaC plan, runbook, KT, hypercare, rollback, and cost evidence.
